svg.title: Droplet erosion with the canyon constants
svg.desc: Shaded relief, height change and sediment colour after 6000 droplets on a 96 by 96 heightfield with one mesa.
svg.text: canyon (planned): 6000 droplets on a 96 x 96 field, a mesa and two rain plots
b height change (blue cut, orange fill)
c sediment colour = the rain that carried it
white rings: the two rain plots. Mesa plot: 1500 droplets; busy plot: 4500. Constants: inertia 0.05, capacity 4, erode 0.15, deposit 0.3, evaporation 0.01, life 70.
